body:
## Outcome

Make interaction motion consistent, purposeful, and compatible with visual, sound, and haptic feedback.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P1 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Extract durations, easing/spring values, press response, overlay transitions, number animation, skeleton/loading behavior, and disclosure transitions.
- Define press-in, activation, release/cancel, drag, scroll, and outcome timing. Reserve semantic feedback events for the feedback contract rather than hardcoded sound calls.
- Provide web CSS/React and native animation mappings with interruptibility and cancellation behavior.
- Specify reduced-motion alternatives and separate settings for motion, sound, and haptics; repeated live data updates should not create continuous effects.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The motion catalog contains token-backed examples and static/reduced-motion alternatives for each animated pattern.
- [ ] Press cancellation, drag/scroll cancellation, interrupted overlays, and rapid state changes do not leave stale visual state or queued effects.
- [ ] Browser and OS reduced-motion preferences are respected; motion does not alter action outcomes or mask loading/error states.

## Prerequisites

- #8 — Define spacing, geometry, density, and adaptive layout rules

## References

- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Specify motion and gesture behavior with reduced-motion alternatives
